headline: Premier League live updates: Can Man City keep pace with the champions after Arsenal's win vs. Hull?
description: Another weekend of European soccer is underway, with Man City trying to close the gap to the defending champions after Arsenal scraped past Hull City.

headline: If Arsenal find attacking spark, they could run away with the Premier League
description: Arsenal's attack lacked a focal point vs. Hull, but Martin Ødegaard delivered a winner that should have the champions' Premier League rivals worried.
